description: Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs - Order to declare Monday 16th of March, 2020 a Public and Bank Special Holiday to Support Quarantine Process on Corona Virus, This Holiday will be extending if necessary
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a special public and bank holiday under the authority of the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971. The core action is a regulatory/legal order made by a Minister using powers vested by an existing Act of Parliament. While a Minister is named, the announcement is not about a personnel change or a detailed assignment of his portfolio responsibilities; it is about exercising a statutory power to create a legally binding declaration (a special holiday). This fits the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) for matters concerning legal notices, statutory instruments, and regulatory actions.
